title: Roasted Boudin Noir Dumplings
description: A twist on traditional Chinese dumplings, filled with rich roasted boudin noir and perfect for a hearty meal.
instructions: Wrap each dumpling wrapper around a tablespoon of boudin noir, leaving a small border. Seal edges.
Place dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush tops with sesame oil and sprinkle with scallions.
Roast in the oven for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
While dumplings are roasting, heat soy sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
Serve dumplings hot with the garlic-soy sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
